title: Carl Stanley dies a month after his Bronx consecration

tellings.quote: He goes back to Kentucky and he's dead within a month.

plain: In 1965 a man named Carl Stanley went through a consecration, a ceremony that makes someone a bishop, in the Bronx in New York. Then he went back to Kentucky and, in the words of the researcher Peter Levenda, "he's dead within a month." Levenda tells it without naming a source, as a strange turn of events tied to the ceremony.
